---
# Course-wide knitr / Quarto defaults.
# Pages should include this file and then load only the packages that lesson needs.
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    echo: true
    warning: false
    message: false
    fig-align: center
    fig-width: 8
    fig-asp: 0.618
    dpi: 96
    out-width: "100%"
    # ragg is fine for points/lines; fonts are registered with systemfonts below
    # so ggrepel can see the same families. Do not pair ragg with showtext-only fonts.
    fig-format: png
---

#| label: course-setup
#| include: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths: requires execute-dir: project in _quarto.yml
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("here")
}
library(here)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core packages used on almost every page
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggformula)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(showtext)
  library(systemfonts)
  library(sysfonts)
})

# Optional companions — load if installed, do not fail the render if missing
.load_if <- function(pkg) {
  if (requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, character.only = TRUE))
    TRUE
  } else {
    FALSE
  }
}

.load_if("tidyverse")
.load_if("scales")
.load_if("ragg")
.has_tinytable <- .load_if("tinytable")
.has_flextable <- .load_if("flextable")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fonts
# Prefer local files in <project>/fonts so renders work offline.
# Fall back to Google Fonts if a face is missing.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.font_file <- function(...) {
  path <- here::here("fonts", ...)
  if (file.exists(path)) path else NULL
}

.register_face <- function(family, regular, bold = NULL, italic = NULL, bolditalic = NULL,
                           google = family) {
  local_ok <- !is.null(regular) && file.exists(regular)
  if (local_ok) {
    sysfonts::font_add(
      family = family,
      regular = regular,
      bold = if (!is.null(bold) && file.exists(bold)) bold else NULL,
      italic = if (!is.null(italic) && file.exists(italic)) italic else NULL,
      bolditalic = if (!is.null(bolditalic) && file.exists(bolditalic)) bolditalic else NULL
    )
    # ggrepel + ragg read fonts from systemfonts, not from showtext
    try(systemfonts::register_font(
      name = family,
      plain = regular,
      bold = if (!is.null(bold) && file.exists(bold)) bold else regular,
      italic = if (!is.null(italic) && file.exists(italic)) italic else regular,
      bolditalic = if (!is.null(bolditalic) && file.exists(bolditalic)) bolditalic else regular
    ), silent = TRUE)
    return(invisible("local"))
  }
  tryCatch(
    sysfonts::font_add_google(name = google, family = family),
    error = function(e) {
      warning("Could not register font family '", family, "': ", conditionMessage(e))
    }
  )
  invisible("google")
}

showtext::showtext_opts(dpi = 96)

.register_face(
  family = "Alegreya",
  regular    = .font_file("Alegreya-Regular.ttf"),
  bold       = .font_file("Alegreya-Bold.ttf"),
  italic     = .font_file("Alegreya-Italic.ttf"),
  bolditalic = .font_file("Alegreya-BoldItalic.ttf"),
  google     = "Alegreya"
)

.register_face(
  family = "Roboto Condensed",
  regular    = .font_file("RobotoCondensed-Regular.ttf"),
  bold       = .font_file("RobotoCondensed-Bold.ttf"),
  italic     = .font_file("RobotoCondensed-Italic.ttf"),
  bolditalic = .font_file("RobotoCondensed-BoldItalic.ttf"),
  google     = "Roboto Condensed"
)

showtext::showtext_auto(enable = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# House ggplot2 theme (your previous theme_custom)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
theme_madhatter <- function(base_size = 10, exhibit = TRUE) {
  th <- ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 1, r = 2, b = 1, l = 1, unit = "cm"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Roboto Condensed",
        size = 10
      ),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Roboto Condensed",
        size = 8
      ),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Roboto Condensed",
        size = 6
      ),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 8
      ),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 14,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 10
      ),
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 6
      ),
      plot.caption.position = "plot"
    )

  if (isTRUE(exhibit)) {
    th <- th + ggplot2::theme(
      plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(
        fill = "bisque",
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 1
      )
    )
  }

  th
}

# Quiet variant for student-facing “final” charts (no bisque frame)
theme_madhatter_plain <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_madhatter(base_size = base_size, exhibit = FALSE)
}

ggplot2::theme_set(theme_madhatter())

# Geom defaults use fontface + colour. `face` / `color` are ignored or
# break ggrepel (GeomTextRepel does not have a `face` parameter).
.text_defaults <- list(
  family = "Roboto Condensed",
  fontface = "plain",
  size = 3.5,
  colour = "#2b2b2b"
)

ggplot2::update_geom_defaults("text", .text_defaults)
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults("label", .text_defaults)
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults("text_repel", .text_defaults)
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults("label_repel", .text_defaults)

if (requireNamespace("marquee", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(marquee))
  ggplot2::update_geom_defaults("marquee", .text_defaults)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (.has_tinytable) {
  options(
    tinytable_tt_digits = 2,
    tinytable_format_num_fmt = "significant_cell",
    tinytable_html_mathjax = TRUE
  )
}

if (.has_flextable) {
  flextable::set_flextable_defaults(font.family = "Roboto Condensed")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers pages can call without re-copying theme code
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
madhatter_set_theme <- function(exhibit = TRUE) {
  ggplot2::theme_set(
    if (exhibit) theme_madhatter() else theme_madhatter_plain()
  )
  invisible(NULL)
}
